title: Low-contrast inactive/unselected text after re-theme (Sound/Properties/Output tabs, scriptEvent options)
description:
USER-reported legibility nit. After the Flash 8 light re-theme, UNSELECTED/INACTIVE text is too faint to read in several places.

AFFECTED SPOTS (all share ONE token):
1. Bottom dock TAB labels (Timeline | Actions | Sound | Properties | Output) — Shell.tsx bottomTabBtnStyle (line ~2914): inactive tab color = chrome.textDisabled on background chrome.insetFieldStrip (#D4D4D4). Tab ids defined Shell.tsx 470-472 (sound/properties/output).
2. Right-panel TAB labels — Shell.tsx tabBtnStyle (line ~2900): same inactive color = chrome.textDisabled on chrome.insetFieldStrip.
3. scriptEvent options (Actions panel event sidebars) — ActionsPanel.tsx lines 1125, 1228, 1329: unselected event option with no script => color chrome.textDisabled, on sidebar background chrome.insetFieldStrip (#D4D4D4). Three modes affected: button-instance on() list, button-symbol event list, movieclip onClipEvent list.

TOKEN + HEX:
- chrome.textDisabled = #808080 (packages/authoring-ui/src/theme/flash8Theme.ts, ~line 'Disabled / dimmed label text'). ALL affected spots resolve to this single token.

COMPUTED WCAG CONTRAST (sRGB):
- #808080 inactive text on #D4D4D4 (actual tab/event-sidebar bg) = 2.66:1  <-- DEFECT (matches prior QA ~2.8:1 note)
- #808080 on #ECECEC (panelBg) = 3.34:1
- #808080 on #FFFFFF = 3.95:1
All below WCAG AA 4.5:1; the actual 2.66:1 is below even the 3:1 large-text floor. (Active/selected text is chrome.textDefault #000000 = 17.78:1 on #ECECEC — fine.)

ROOT CAUSE:
The shared chrome.textDisabled (#808080) token — spec'd in docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md System A table as 'Disabled / dimmed label text' (best-estimate) — is being reused for the INACTIVE-but-still-interactive state (unselected tabs, selectable event options). It is only legible enough for genuinely disabled controls, not for clickable inactive labels. Real Flash 8 inactive tab text is dark/legible, not a faint gray.

EXPECTED vs ACTUAL:
- Expected: inactive/unselected labels remain readable — ~4.5:1+ vs their #D4D4D4/#ECECEC backgrounds, matching Flash 8's darker inactive tab text.
- Actual: 2.66:1 (#808080 on #D4D4D4), too faint.

FIX DIRECTION:
Darken the inactive-text token so unselected labels stay readable. Either (a) darken chrome.textDisabled itself (e.g. #595959 => 4.73:1 on #D4D4D4 / 5.93:1 on #ECECEC, or #4d4d4d => 5.7:1 / 7.16:1) — note this also affects every other chrome.textDisabled consumer (PropertiesPanel, Timeline gutters, dialogs, etc.), which is acceptable/beneficial; OR (b) introduce a dedicated chrome.textInactive token (~#595959) for the interactive-but-unselected states (the 5 spots above) and leave chrome.textDisabled for genuinely-disabled controls. Keep selected/active text as-is (chrome.textDefault #000000). Update docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md token table to match whichever approach is chosen. Verify against the contrast figures above.

Priority LOW (legibility nit). HEAD at filing: 1fd521e3cf638a46b3f3a2311222993820ab01e2.
